buildInfo.reason: Missing: address-bound constructor values and provider route fields. Resolve: materialize the provider graph after preflight and retain a fresh launch build. Verified alternative: this single pinned-profile build binds template bytecode and source content while all signable graph fields remain unset.

postDeployAssertions: No graph transaction is signable until the provider supplies the encoded token-allocate, custody-bind-hook and hook-initialize-graph-launch calls in that order.
The three predicted addresses must have the exact materialized runtime hashes before the seed transaction is signed.
The hook address must satisfy permission mask 0x20cc.
The resolved PoolKey must use fee 0, spacing 60, the resolved currency ordering and the resolved hook.
The token balance and custody position must match the reconciled token allocation before the launch is considered complete.
The Permit2 allowance must be exact, live at signing time and cleared by the seed path.

requiredGraphCalls.reason: The graph factory allocates the fixed supply after all target addresses are resolved.
The custody binds the resolved hook before the launch graph is initialized.
The graph initializer binds custody and initializes the canonical pool in one source-authorized call.

metadata.description: Hookemon buys gacha card packs, opens them, sells the cards and pays the proceeds to HKMN holders. Trading fees fund the packs.
metadata.name: Hookemon

openFacts: Missing: provider-supplied encoded preimage for the accepted three-call initialization sequence token.allocate(hook), custody.configureBindingHook(hook), and hook.initializeGraphLaunch(custody,sqrtPriceX96). Resolve: obtain the route namespace, route nonce, topology hash, target-id hashes, and serialized provider graph call data. Verified alternative: retain no encoded call data, target addresses, or signing payload.

Missing: the CREATE2 HKMN and hook addresses. Resolve: derive them after the provider route and salts are fixed, then select the lower-address currency order and price candidate. Verified alternative: retain both computed orderings and leave PoolKey, PoolId and selection unset.

Missing: owner-selected seed deadline, Permit2 expiration, wallet nonce and gas parameters. Resolve: collect them from Rabby after final preflight and record the signed values. Verified alternative: retain the 900-second deadline ceiling and exact-allowance rule without a transaction payload.

Missing: icon and banner bytes, content hashes and immutable publication locations. Resolve: add the supplied assets to the package and bind their SHA-256 values. Verified alternative: publish no public metadata artifact and retain the owner text only.

Missing: provider route fields, applicant salts and effective salts. Resolve: bind the provider route record and run deterministic address derivation. Verified alternative: keep addresses and graph digest unset while retaining only template hash evidence.

Missing: address-bound constructor arguments and encoded graph calls. Resolve: derive final target addresses, bind authority values and encode the required graph-call sequence. Verified alternative: retain null initializer calldata and prohibit signing.

Missing: the minted position token ID. Resolve: read the PositionManager mint result after the owner seed transaction and bind it through PermanentPositionCustody.bindMintedPosition. Verified alternative: deploy custody with constructor tokenId 0 and do not claim a bound position before seed.

Missing: final token and hook addresses. Resolve: run CREATE2 derivation after route fields are frozen and calculate the canonical PoolKey and PoolId. Verified alternative: retain the two address-order price candidates and leave pool identifiers unset.

deadlinePolicy.reason: The contract only requires a future deadline; the signed value must be created after the final preflight response.

permit2Allowance.amountRule: Exact selected USDG amount0Max or amount1Max; the hook sets and clears its downstream approval during the seed call.

selection.rule: Compare the resolved HKMN CREATE2 address with the fixed USDG address. The lower address is currency0.

refundAndDust.sourceBehavior: Unused USDG is returned to the payer. A graph-mode seed requires zero HKMN residual after the position mint; any residual reverts the complete seed, including funding, mint, approvals, and custody binding.

unverified.reason: Missing provider-supplied route namespace, route nonce, topology hash, target-id hashes, and serialized graph call data needed to derive the launchIntentHash preimage.
Provider preflight requires an authorized API key in the execution environment; the key is never persisted in this package.
The owner must fund the launch wallet and bind the final nonce, gas parameters and deadline after provider preflight.

Missing: the builder public repository and contact. Resolve: bind the owner-provided public repository identity before preflight. Verified alternative: retain anonymous builder fields and block a provider-ready package.
